------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Jagdish Chand

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
1 For the Petitioner: Mr. Munish Datwalia, Legal Aid
Counsel.

For the Respondent:
r Mr. L.N. Sharma, Additional Advocate General with Ms. Leena Guleria, Deputy
Advocate General.

The petitioner has preferred this petition seeking regular bail in FIR No.149/2021, dated 18.10.2021, registered under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code at Police Station Dharamshala, District Kangra, H.P.
2. Heard.
3.
From the case file, it appears that the previous bail applications moved by the petitioner were dismissed on merits by the learned Trial Court on 11.01.2022, 29.03.2022 and 15.10.2022.
Learned counsel for the Whether reporters of print and electronic media may be allowed to see the order?
Yes petitioner submits that there is now change in the circumstance.

4. In view of the submission made by learned .
counsel for the petitioner, it would be appropriate for the petitioner to move the learned Trial Court in the first instance, pointing out the changed circumstance.

The petition stands disposed of in the above terms, so also the pending miscellaneous application(s),
if any.
The petitioner shall be at liberty to move a fresh petition in accordance with law, in case need so arises in future.
